% Checks a case the use of a .bbl beside the document must not break:
% every .bib that \bibliography names is there, one by name and one by a
% ../ path with its .bib extension. bibtex runs, as latexmk runs it, and
% the stale .bbl beside is not read.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Citations~\cite{groups,lattices}.
\bibliographystyle{plain}
\bibliography{test-bibindex,../fixtures/test-bibpath.bib}
\end{document}
